hint.permission: Fix: in LBank → API management enable “Read” for this key, and if it has an IP whitelist add your current IP.
hint.futures_permission: Futures fix: the API key needs the “Contract” permission (LBank → API management). Without it only spot is shown.
hint.signature: Fix: re-enter the Secret key without extra spaces in Settings → Exchange accounts. The key must be HmacSHA256 (not RSA).
hint.key: Fix: the API key is invalid or expired; create a new key in LBank and replace it in Settings.
hint.clock: Fix: sync the Windows clock with the internet (Settings → Time → Sync now); a clock offset makes requests fail.
hint.region: The exchange is not answering because of a regional restriction.
hint.network: Fix: check your internet/VPN; the app retries every 60 seconds.
hint.generic: If it persists, press “Test connection” in Settings → Exchange accounts.
hint.blocked: Fix: the LBank futures domain (lbkperp.lbank.com) is behind Cloudflare, which rejected the request before the API key was checked — so the key is not the problem (spot uses another domain and works). Turn on a system-wide VPN/proxy or pick another server/country — some data-centre and country IPs are refused — then press Sync.
hint.blocked_region: Fix: Cloudflare blocks the LBank futures domain for your current IP's country/region (code 1009); the API key is not the problem. Sync again through a system-wide VPN/proxy on a server in an allowed country.
